Title: Sanjay's Day

Cast

1. Sanjay - 34 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Hema - 56 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Nitin - 36 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The forest - tall trees, thick bushes
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The forest - Day

[Sanjay stands in the forest. Hema stands near him.]

Sanjay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Sanjay goes hunting and aims his bow at a deer.]

Hema: "I knew it!"

[Sanjay rides an elephant through the forest.]

Hema: "Careful!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Sanjay stands on the road. Hema stands near him.]

Sanjay: "Let's begin."

[Sanjay starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Sanjay: "Mom, listen!"

[Sanjay is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Sanjay: "Careful!"

[Sanjay steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Sanjay: "I knew it!"

[Sanjay loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Hema (excited): "Hmm, I see."

Scene 3: The road - Day

Sanjay: "Let's begin."

[Sanjay rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Sanjay: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Sanjay takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Hema: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
